title: Former Spartan, Junior Fehoko, keeps grinding on the next stop of a hard NFL road

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Former Spartan, Junior Fehoko, keeps grinding on the next stop of a hard NFL road
sources.description: Viliami “Junior” Fehoko has never played a regular-season snap in the NFL. But two years in and three franchises deep hasn’t stopped him from showing up. On Monday, the Bay Area native landed with the San Francisco 49ers, the latest stop in a league that has tested him at every turn. A hometown kid built […]
